summary: IAMGOLD, a Canadian gold producer listed in Toronto and on the NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K (the US foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) containing its third-quarter 2026 results news release dated November 5, 2026. Quarterly attributable production was 186,900 ounces, revenue $856.5 million at a $4,277/oz realized price, net earnings $297.0 million, and mine-site free cash flow $404 million, with liquidity of $1.6 billion. The company repurchased $135 million of shares, nearly $600 million since December, and flagged an upcoming buyback of half of Franco-Nevada's Côté royalty. No transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed; the routine earnings release carries no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
